_comment: Maps the agency tokens on https://its.ny.gov/dcts to the agency names used in this dashboard (axe Monitor Scan Group names plus any override names). A token also matches an agency of the same name, case-insensitively, without an entry here, so an entry only has to list the EXTRA names a token should cover. Re-run `npm run generate` (or `generate:offline`) after editing.

FCB: New York State Financial Control Board
